name: BC556
description: PNP small-signal transistor in the European BC556-560 family, the high-voltage -65V member and complement to the NPN BC546. Same TO-92 C-B-E pinout as the BC557. Values are magnitudes; PNP rails are negative.

TO-92.notes: flat face toward you, leads down: C-B-E (BC556-560 family layout, same as BC557).

typical_application: High-side switching and PNP small-signal stages needing more than 45V, complement to the BC546 in higher-voltage complementary circuits.
gotchas: pinout is C-B-E, the European convention, opposite the American 2N3906 (E-B-C)
PNP: all ratings negative; emitter to the more positive node, base pulled low to turn on
highest-voltage member of the BC556 family (-65V)
